purpose: Remote-reviewable mechanical import of the accepted frozen 113-file production baseline without local-main history.

source_audit.source_transport: local accepted Git objects only; no production export and no dirty-worktree copy

git_mode_normalization.explanation: Git trees preserve only executable versus non-executable mode bits; group-read/write bits are not representable. The isolated worktree was chmod 0640 for validation, while the PR tree necessarily records 100644.

py_compile.bytecode_location: isolated temporary PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX outside the worktree

serialized_tests.execution: serial, candidate PYTHONPATH, temporary SQLite paths, Meta live writes disabled

diff_check.disposition: Retained byte-for-byte because both lines are part of the accepted frozen source object; changing them would violate the mechanical baseline contract.

exclusions: the 30 local-main commits after origin/main and their unrelated files
environment contents, credentials, databases, caches, bytecode, backups, receipts, logs, and runtime state
functional changes, formatting, refactors, or fixes
push, pull request creation, merge, deployment, production write, Meta write, and backend restart
